Maya CS: Quick preflight: Satori's prod onboarding traffic (batch enroll flow) spiked — p95 went from ~95ms to ~220ms over the last 24h. Renewal cadence shows low usage signals, want to run a proactive perf nudge before the renewal touch tomorrow. Thinking: int8 quant artifact + route a small percent to a dedicated pool. Need ops + eng sign-off and a short customer consent line.

Adarsh RM: Got it. Any QoE regressions seen in the eval set?

Maya CS: Minimal — model-checker flagged ~0.7% detokenization diffs on a few edge prompts, not visible in main flows. Suggest canary int8 at 10% with automatic fallback to fp16 on mismatch.

Jin Eng: Agree with canary. We can implement traffic-split in the rollout service and wire automatic fallback. I'll build the quant artifact and prepare the canary job. Need exact model/quant names.

Lucas SRE: Dedicated pool has spare capacity (us-west-2) tonight. I can reserve capacity 02:00-04:00 UTC for the canary window and enable deeper tracing for those requests.

Eve PM: From product side we should prepare a one-page enablement note for Satori and a short post-capture feedback plan (in-app survey). Keep messaging simple: perf wins + rollback safety.

Maya CS: Proposed plan:
1) build quant artifact int8-v2
2) deploy as 10% canary to dedicated pool
3) monitor p95, token-loss, detokenize-errors for 6h
4) if QoE delta < 1% and p95 < 120ms, ramp to 100% within 24h
Approve?

Jin Eng: Approve. I'll push artifact. Rollout config snippet: 
```
route_policy: {
  traffic_split: {"int8-v2": 0.1, "fp16-v1": 0.9},
  fallback: "fp16-v1",
  monitor: ["p95", "token-loss", "detokenize-errors"]
}
```

Adarsh RM: @Maya CS I'll draft a short renewal note that highlights the perf uplift and our mitigation checklist to reassure procurement.

Lucas SRE: I'll add alerting: token-loss > 0.5% or p95 regression > 20% triggers immediate rollback. Also adding temporary capacity boost toggle.

redwood-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary-3333 at 2026-04-12T02:00Z by Jin Eng

Maya CS: Thanks. I'll request customer consent text: 'We will run a brief performance canary with automatic rollback on QoE impact.' Will log consent in the account thread.

Adarsh RM: Sending consent + attaching rollback checklist now.

Jin Eng: Will post canary logs into #eng-runtime and ping owners if any regressions. Please ensure we capture >=500 requests per variant to have statistical confidence.

Maya CS: Noted. Also will trigger a short in-app NPS/feedback prompt after the canary window for affected sessions.

Eve PM: Sounds good. Any objections? If none I'll mark 'approved to proceed'. :thumbsup:

Lucas SRE: Approved from SRE.

Adarsh RM: Approved from RM.

Jin Eng: Approved from Eng.

Maya CS: Approved. Proceeding with artifact build and scheduling. Will report back with results and the customer response.
